entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's a piece of junk and I'm not paying for it.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To get started, could you please confirm your name and order number?
The name is Mark Sterling. I don't have the order number in front of me, you should be able to find it. Just process the return. Now.

Okay, Mr. Sterling. I'm pulling up your account now... I see it. The VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on January 11th. I understand you'd like to return it, but to process this correctly, I need to know what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Don't give me your script! The whole interface is just plain **hard to use**. It's incredibly **confusing**, and frankly, I **expected more** from a VeloFit product. I've read the **user manual** and it's useless. Are you going to process this return or do I need to speak to your manager?
No, no, that won't be necessary, sir. I can absolutely handle this for you. I understand your frustration. Let me just check the return eligibility for you right now.
You'd better. I'm one step away from plastering a bad review all over your website and social media.

I understand. One moment... Okay, I've checked our policy. Your delivery date was January 11th, which was 12 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so I can go ahead and approve this return immediately.
Wait, really? 90 days? Okay... so you're just taking it back? No more questions?

That's correct. I've just initiated the return in our system. A pre-paid shipping label has been sent to the email address on your account. Please package the device in its original box, apply the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. You'll receive a full refund within 3-5 business days after we receive the item.
Oh. Well... great. That was actually much easier than I expected. Thank you, Isaac.
You're very welcome, Mr. Sterling. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
